Job Details

Company

Job Details

SIAT extends a formal invitation to distinguished researchers, scientists, and engineers from across the globe to explore career opportunities with us. We are actively seeking exceptional candidates in our key strategic fields, including but not limited to: Advanced Integration Technology, Biomedical and Health Engineering, Advanced Computing and Digital Engineering, Biomedicine and Biotechnology, Brain Cognition and Brain Disease, Synthetic Biology, Advanced Materials Science and Engineering, Technology for Carbon Neutrality and Scientific Instrumentation.

We are building a vibrant community and invite scholars at all levels to join our scientific journey. We also rely on the insights of our global network and warmly welcome your recommendations for outstanding colleagues.

Positions and Qualifications

Distinguished PIs

Recognized academic achievements and contributions;
Evidence of international reputation and influence;
Ability to lead the development of disciplines or catch up with the international advanced level.

PIs

Hold a PhD degree;
Primarily engage in research directions in the natural sciences, engineering technology, etc.;
Generally should have held a formal teaching or research position at a renowned overseas university, research institution, or corporate R&D institution for a continuous period of 36 months or more; for those who have obtained a doctoral degree overseas and have exceptional achievements, the work experience requirement may be appropriately relaxed (not applicable to those who obtained their overseas doctoral degree through Sino-foreign joint training programs);
Have obtained research or technological achievements recognized by peer experts and have the potential to become an academic leader or outstanding talent in the field;

Young Scientists

Applicants must be younger than 40 years old as of the application date.
Have conducted systematic research in their field with a proven track record of outstanding academic achievements.
Possess forward-looking research interests and a well-defined research plan that aligns with SIAT’s strategic development priorities.
Demonstrate strong independent research capabilities, along with the ability to organize and lead a research team, exhibiting exceptional academic creativity and significant potential for scientific and technological innovation.

Post-doctoral

Hold a Ph.D. diploma and graduation certificate obtained within the last 3 years.
Applicants should generally be 35 years of age or below (inclusive), and be Chinese or foreign citizens who can engage in full-time research work at our institute.
Possess excellent moral character, academic excellence, and physical and mental health, with demonstrated high academic standards and strong research capabilities.

Other positions:

Professorate Senior Engineer, Research Assistant, Assistant Engineer etc.

Compensation and Benefits

We offer a competitive job support and create a dedicated research environment for you:

Development Potential: We offer you a one-stop career platform integrating research, education, and industrial resources, where you will collaborate with a high caliber team, fostering innovation and professional growth..

Compensation and Benefits: We provide internationally competitive, academically focused negotiated salaries and benefits to enable you to focus on your research.

Research Support: We provide substantial research funding and dedicated laboratory space to fully support your research endeavors.

Team Support: We provide dedicated support for recruiting research staff to help you efficiently build your research team.

Project Application: We offer comprehensive support and guidance throughout the application process for various funding programs, allowing you to concentrate on core research.

Relocation Assistance: We assist you in securing talent housing, provide corresponding housing purchase subsidies, and implement various levels of living subsidies for high-level talents.

Medical and Health: We offer access to high-end medical resources, annual health check-ups, and designated hospital medical services.

Children's Education: We provide educational resources from kindergarten through junior high school, including school enrollment and childcare arrangements.

Other Benefits: Generous achievement awards, stable promotion opportunities, and customized personnel services (including household registration, residency, archives, and entry permits for China).

Application Guide

We welcome outstanding talents to send your CV and representative research achievements to recruit@siat.ac.cn. For post-doctoral positions, please send applications to postdoctor.hr@siat.ac.cn. The email subject should be "Your Name + Research Field". We will precisely match your profile with relevant research institutes based on your expertise.
